🛠️ Design 的模块化 GenAI 工作流程 – Delta 版本

的达美发布Desaign 的旗舰模块化工作流程就在这里——比以往更快、更轻、更清晰。
该版本重点关注性能、简单性和控制，同时还引入了两种风格的工作流程以满足不同的需求。

与 Gamma 版本相比，Delta 带来了一些改进。一个否定提示输入添加了对世代的更精确控制，同时Florence2 和 JoyCaption现在已集成以提供更强大的字幕和文本解释。我们还包括键盘快捷键加快导航速度并简化日常使用。

同时，我们删除了一些元素，使工作流程更精简、更高效。的多次预览该功能已被删除，以减少混乱和资源使用。的集成升频器和通量上下文模块也被删除，因为我们现在为这些任务提供完全专用的工作流程——为每个工具提供独立发展的空间。

除了新功能之外，达美航空还在引擎盖下进行了大量优化。计算成本已降低，管道和连接的数量已减少到最低限度，原始加载时间现在大大缩短，使得工作流程即使在要求苛刻的设置下也能更顺畅地运行。

达美航空也加入其中两个版本:

  • 设计_Delta_raw，纯粹形式的精简工作流程。

  • 设计_Delta_UI，经过重新设计的界面的精美版本，更适合4K分辨率屏幕.

我们尝试了基于子图的版本，但当前的限制使其对于这种复杂的工作流程来说不稳定。尽管我们计划在基础技术改进后重新考虑该路径，但目前该路径已被搁置。

🛠️ Design 的模块化 GenAI 工作流程 – Gamma 版本

的伽马释放Desaign 的旗舰模块化工作流程就在这里——从头开始重建，变得更智能、更干净、更直观。

无论您是经验丰富的 AI 艺术家还是刚刚开始使用 ComfyUI，此版本都提供了两全其美的功能：完全模块化控制和初学者友好的可用性。

🔄 主要特点：

  • ✅ 完全重新设计的用户界面
    整个界面经过重新设计，更加清晰和简单——对于新手来说是理想的选择，对于高级用户来说速度更快。

  • 🎚️ 基于滑块的控件
    所有主要参数现在都以滑块的形式公开，无需手动深入节点。

  • 🎲 添加了种子选择器
    您现在可以通过单个输入轻松控制生成随机性或锁定结果。

  • ⚡ 快速组旁路器
    立即打开或关闭整个模块，而不会中断流程——非常适合快速测试或选择性通过。

📦 工作流程结构：

每个模块（提示、ControlNet、参考、LoRA、详细信息）都是独立且可选的。只需插入您需要的东西即可 - 系统会自动适应。

🛠️ Desaign’s Modular GenAI Workflow – Delta Version

TheDelta releaseof Desaign’s flagship modular workflow is here — faster, lighter, and sharper than ever.
This version focuses onperformance, simplicity, and control, while also introducing two flavors of the workflow to suit different needs.

Compared to the Gamma release, Delta brings several refinements. Anegative prompt inputhas been added for more precise control over generations, whileFlorence2 and JoyCaptionare now integrated to provide stronger captioning and text interpretation. We’ve also includedkeyboard shortcutsto speed up navigation and streamline day-to-day use.

At the same time, we removed a few elements to make the workflow leaner and more efficient. Themultiple previewsfeature has been dropped to reduce clutter and resource usage. Theintegrated upscalerandFlux Kontextmodules have also been taken out, since we now provide fully dedicated workflows for those tasks — giving each tool the space to evolve independently.

Beyond new features, Delta has beenheavily optimized under the hood. Computing costs have been reduced, the number of pipes and connections has been trimmed to the minimum, and original load times are now much shorter, making the workflow smoother to run even on demanding setups.

Delta also comes intwo versions:

  • Desaign_Delta_raw, the stripped-down workflow in its pure form.

  • Desaign_Delta_UI, a polished edition with a redesigned interface, better suited to4K resolution screens.

We experimented with a subgraph-based edition, but current limitations made it unstable for a workflow of this complexity. That path is on hold for now, though we plan to revisit it when the underlying tech improves.

🛠️ Desaign’s Modular GenAI Workflow – Gamma Version

TheGamma releaseof Desaign’s flagship modular workflow is here — rebuilt from the ground up to be smarter, cleaner, and drastically more intuitive.

Whether you're a seasoned AI artist or just getting started with ComfyUI, this version delivers the best of both worlds: full modular controlandbeginner-friendly usability.

🔄 Key Features:

  • ✅ Completely Redesigned UI
    The entire interface has been restructured for clarity and simplicity — ideal for newcomers and faster for advanced users.

  • 🎚️ Slider-Based Controls
    All major parameters are now exposed as sliders, removing the need to manually dive into nodes.

  • 🎲 Seed Selector Added
    You can now easily control generation randomness or lock results with a single input.

  • ⚡ Fast Group Bypasser
    Instantly toggle entire modules on or off without breaking the flow — perfect for rapid testing or selective passes.

📦 Workflow Structure:

Each module (prompting, ControlNet, referencing, LoRAs, detailers) is self-contained and optional. Simply plug in what you need — the system adapts automatically.

Required image inputs on first launch:

  • Base Image

  • ControlNet Image

  • Three Reference Images (can be empty if not used)

🧩 Related Tools in the Desaign Ecosystem:

  • 🎨 Inpaint Anything Anywhere (Flux Fill replacement)
    → https://civitai.com/models/1784606/desaign-inpaint-anything-anywhere

    → https://civitai.com/models/1830260/desaign-wan22-unified

  • 🔍 Desaign Upscaler (advanced upscale workflow)
    → https://civitai.com/models/1717254/desaign-upscaler

  • 🎨 Desaign Kontext Edit & Inpaint(precision editing with Flux Kontext)
    → https://civitai.com/models/1881589/desaign-kontext-edit-and-inpaint

  • The optional"Immersive AI Experience"(audio meme mode) has been removed.
